name: Channel breakout
idea: A signal on the first close beyond the far edge of a channel: above the upper edge of a rising channel, or below the lower edge of a falling one. The idea has ended when the close is back inside.

params.label: Line touches
params.help: How many swings must touch the channel's main line.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the channel edge the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The level that says the breakout failed: just beyond the broken edge, the channel's other line, or its middle.

params.label: Edge buffer
params.help: For 'just beyond the broken edge': how many average true ranges beyond the edge.
